name: manager-site
description: Manager landing + Payload CMS on Cloudflare D1/R2

scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:database && npm run deploy:app
scripts.deploy:app: npx --no-install opennextjs-cloudflare build --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV && npx --no-install opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV
scripts.deploy:database: cross-env NODE_ENV=production PAYLOAD_SECRET=ignore npx --no-install payload migrate && npx --no-install wrangler d1 execute D1 --command 'PRAGMA optimize' --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV --remote
scripts.devsafe: rm -rf .next && rm -rf .open-next && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next dev
scripts.generate:types: npm run generate:types:cloudflare && npm run generate:types:payload
scripts.preview: npx --no-install opennextjs-cloudflare build && npx --no-install opennextjs-cloudflare preview --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV

PAYLOAD_SECRET.description: Generate a random string using `openssl rand -hex 32`
